scope: Root native Engine CPU frame through the winit/softbuffer example on a real X11 protocol surface supplied by Xvfb.

one_frame_clean_exit.observed: winit created the X11 window, softbuffer acquired its surface and presented one Blitz/Vello CPU frame; the translated event stream contained ImeEnabled(false) and pointer Hover.

gpu_one_frame_clean_exit.observed: The host won the X11 Surface and wgpu device; Engine rendered through Vello hybrid directly into the acquired Surface texture and the host queue presented it.

resize_capture.observed: The X11 configure/resize path repainted the complete 640x360 surface; both fixed 200x120 rectangles remained at 24000 pixels each.

limitations: Xvfb provides a real X11 protocol surface but not a compositor, window manager, hardware display controller or vsync.
The resize capture validates repaint and surface reconfiguration, not suspend/resume delivery by a platform session manager.
The capture script terminates the long-running diagnostic after taking both screenshots; the separate --once run validates clean application exit after present.
The GPU window uses the llvmpipe software Vulkan adapter; no hardware GPU swapchain, device-loss recovery, real system accessibility bridge or live external IME service is claimed.
The scene/update orchestration proof remains separate; this report is presentation integration evidence.
